description: The virality engine. Find the posts that are actually outperforming in the user's niche on X, rank them by how far each beat its own account, break each one down into hook, structure and format, then recreate the winners in the user's own voice for their audience. Use when the user says "find viral posts", "what's working on X right now", "what are people posting in my niche", "reverse engineer this account", "build me a swipe file", "why did this tweet blow up", "recreate this post for me", or has nothing to post and no evidence to decide with.
